headline: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi met with H.E. fullText:
Prime Minister's Office

Prime Minister meets with the Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Thailand on the sidelines the ASEAN Summit in Manila

17 NOV 2026 4:02PM by PIB Delhi

Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi met with H.E. Mr. Anutin Charnvirakul, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Thailand, on the sidelines of the 23rd India - ASEAN Summit and 21st East Asia Summit in Manila on 17 November 2026.

The meeting provided an opportunity to review the progress made in bilateral ties, which were elevated to Strategic Partnership during Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi's visit to Thailand in April 2025. The two leaders discussed ways to further deepen cooperation across key sectors, including trade and investment, defence and security, connectivity, digital technologies and fintech, culture, tourism and people-to-people ties. They also underscored the importance of working closely together in regional forums such as BIMSTEC, IORA, Mekong Ganga Cooperation, and the ASEAN-led architecture. Both leaders also exchanged views on various regional and global issues of mutual importance and reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthening their partnership.

India and Thailand share a time-tested friendship rooted in their shared civilizational and cultural heritage, people-to-people ties and mutual trust. Thailand is an important partner within the framework of India's Act East Policy and our Comprehensive Strategic Partnership with ASEAN.

(Release ID: 2337423)

headline: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi met today H.E. Mr. Lawrence Wong, Prime Minister of Singapore, on the sidelines of the 23rd India - ASEAN Summit and 21st East Asia Summit in Manila.
fullText:
Prime Minister's Office

Prime Minister meets with the Prime Minister of Singapore on the sidelines of the ASEAN Summit in Manila

17 NOV 2026 4:00PM by PIB Delhi

Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi met today H.E. Mr. Lawrence Wong, Prime Minister of Singapore, on the sidelines of the 23rd India - ASEAN Summit and 21st East Asia Summit in Manila.

The leaders reviewed progress under the Roadmap for the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, adopted during Prime Minister Wong’s Official Visit to India in September 2025, and discussed the way forward across the eight priority areas including economic cooperation, skills development, digitalisation, sustainability, connectivity, healthcare and medicine, defence and security cooperation, and people-to-people and cultural exchanges. The leaders also exchanged views on regional and global developments.

Prime Minister conveyed his best wishes for Singapore's upcoming Chairship of ASEAN. He assured Prime Minister Wong of India's full support for its success.

(Release ID: 2337422)
